title: IRYNA II - Benetti 50m
highlights: Interior by Salvagni Architetti, exterior by RWD
description:
IRYNA II is a 49.9-metre Benetti superyacht delivered in 2021, with exterior lines by RWD and interiors by Salvagni Architetti. At 499 GT, her steel hull offers the volume and seakeeping expected of a true superyacht.

She welcomes ten guests in five cabins, looked after by a crew of nine. Twin MAN V12 engines give a cruising speed of 12.5 knots. RINA classed and flying the British flag, she is lying in Genoa, Italy.
